text_block_list.text:
On the day of the Osaka Hai, the spring GⅠ 
where top contenders gather—

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, the fans are super fired up too, 
aren't they~?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"Of course! My engine's in the red zone 
too! After all, I get to run with Rudolf!"

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna thoroughly enjoy seeing the true 
strength of the one they call the 
"Emperor"!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, there's no speed limit on the turf, 
after all. I'm going to blaze through at 
full speed~!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Maruzen-san is coming out! Look, look, 
Grass-chan!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Spe-chan, calm down. Please keep quiet in 
the paddock... okay?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my, is that you guys!? Did you come 
all the way to Hanshin just to watch?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I wanted to see Maruzensky-san's 
running with my own two eyes.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if that's for the sake of the 
Yasuda Kinen? If so, I've got to give it 
everything I've got!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I'll be cheering you on with everything 
I've got, so do your best!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, there's no way I could show an 
uncool race right in front of my cute 
juniors.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I'll show you the greatest run... and a 
back you can't help but want to chase 
after!
